items.t: Condos split between downtown Chilliwack Proper (Yale Road, Young Road, Five Corners) and Sardis (Vedder Road, Campus Drive, Thomas Road).
Downtown buildings sit in the Downtown Plan, Schedule B3 of the 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), centred on Five Corners.
Downtown apartments (R6, C9) and low-rise elsewhere (R5) share minimums: lot 1,000 square metres, width 30 metres.
Newmark, 46289 Yale Road: building named in City council minutes.
Mountainview Lane, 8497 Young Road: named in City records for development permit DP001022.
Newest Sardis stock: York Residences, Campus Drive, run as rentals by Diverse (see sardis-condos-for-sale).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Strata Property Act governs these buildings; provincial guidance covers bylaws, fees and depreciation reports.
Part of downtown sits in the Mountain View Heritage Conservation Area, OCP Schedule C, adding heritage review to exterior changes.
Downtown buildings are in Development Permit Area 6 (Downtown) for form and character (City guide, December 2025).
Downtown flood proofing requires habitable rooms above the flood construction level, behind a 1-in-200-year dyke (Downtown Plan).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Chilliwack Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library) is at 45860 First Avenue, beside Salish Park.
Central Elementary Community School, Chilliwack Middle and Chilliwack Secondary are named in the downtown plan area.
Leisure centres sit outside the clusters: Chilliwack Landing, 9145 Corbould Street; Cheam, 45501 Market Way.
Five Corners joins Yale Road, Young Road, Princess Avenue and Empress Avenue; the City's Urban Quarter lands sit on it.
Chilliwack General Hospital: 45600 Menholm Road (Fraser Health).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Mixed-use rezoning RZ001689, 46118 and 46126 Victoria Avenue and 46245–46271 Yale Road: applicant Architecture Panel Inc.; amend C9 to permit homes on the same storey as commercial, rezone Yale parcels to C9. Status: public hearing December 2, 2025 (as of November 3, 2026); adoption and count not stated.
Five Corners lands (Yale, Young, Princess, Empress): City sought a developer for 3.75 acres of City-owned land. Status: request for proposals (as of November 3, 2026); developer and count not stated.
Andmar, York Residences: see sardis-condos-for-sale.
No City or provincial page publishes strata fees; provincial guidance states fees come from each strata corporation's owner-approved budget.
In rental buildings such as York Residences, the Speculation and Vacancy Tax declaration is the owner's, not the tenant's.
Downtown Chilliwack is BC Transit's city exchange: routes 51, 52, 53, 55, 57, 58, 59, 66, 71, 72 terminate there.
Route 57 Broadway: Downtown Chilliwack to Cottonwood Mall, 45585 Luckakuck Way.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Downtown sits in the Fraser River floodplain: Bylaw No. 4519 sets a 60-metre setback and floors at flood construction level plus 0.6 metres.
Heritage Conservation Area buildings carry controls beyond strata rules; check OCP Schedule C.
Read the depreciation report, Form B and strata insurance before buying (provincial guidance).

faq.a: In two clusters. Downtown, records name Newmark at 46289 Yale Road and Mountainview Lane at 8497 Young Road, around Five Corners. In Sardis, the Campus Drive buildings and Andmar on Thomas Road form the second cluster. Elsewhere, apartments are scattered singles in R5 and R6 zones.

Part of downtown is. The Mountain View Heritage Conservation Area, Schedule C of the Official Community Plan, covers part of the downtown residential area, described in the Downtown Plan as one of the city's first neighbourhoods. Buildings inside it face heritage controls on exterior work, beyond strata bylaws.
faq.q: Is a downtown condo in a heritage area?

faq.a: Both answers come from the building's strata bylaws, summarized in the Form B the Province directs buyers to read for that building. One Sardis exception: at York Residences the operator's page states pets are not allowed, as Diverse-run rentals, not strata.
faq.q: Can I rent it out, or keep a pet?

faq.a: The Downtown Chilliwack exchange itself. BC Transit lists it as terminus for city routes, including Route 66 to Lougheed Town Centre Station, Route 57 to Cottonwood Mall and Route 71 to Agassiz. A Sardis condo relies on Route 51 or 54 to reach it.
